is_anopheles.evidence: The study focuses on Anopheles gambiae s.l. (page 2, abstract).

reports_target_markers.evidence: The paper reports the L1014F (kdr-west) mutation (page 4, 'Detection of the Kdr gene (L1014F)').

reports_extractable_genotype_data.evidence: Table 3 (page 12) provides genotype counts (RR, Rs, ss) for An. gambiae s.s., An. coluzzii, hybrids, and other species across three sites.

african_field_population.evidence: Mosquitoes were collected from field sites in Kwilu Province, Democratic Republic of Congo (page 3, 'Study site').

is_primary_study.evidence: This is an empirical study reporting original field collection and laboratory analysis.

sub_country_location.evidence: The study specifies three districts: Bandundu-city, Bagata, and Vanga (page 3).

temporal_resolution_within_3y.evidence: The study was conducted from October 1st, 2015 to February 1st, 2016 (page 3).

duplicate_risk.evidence: The study describes a new, specific collection in Kwilu Province.

supplement.evidence: All necessary data, including genotype counts and bioassay results, are provided in the main text tables.

assessment.summary: This study investigated insecticide resistance in Anopheles gambiae s.l. populations from three sites in Kwilu Province, DRC. It reports phenotypic resistance to pyrethroids and DDT, metabolic resistance involving P450 oxidases, and the presence of the L1014F kdr mutation, with genotype counts provided for different species.
